_tuning_notes: Saltwater crocodile in mangroves: bigger (scale 1.2), tougher, hits harder, slightly longer grab. Same entity class as nile — the registry proves itself. Phase 3: diet.hunts doubles as cage-trap bait (item form of the prey). RARITY: tier 'uncommon' supplies the spawn weight; group_size and nearby_cap are pinned here (1-2, cap 4). nearby_cap denies natural spawns when that many of this animal are already within 64 blocks — the fix for persistent CREATURE mobs accumulating forever. ECOLOGY 0.4.2: saltwater crocodiles are an estuary/beach animal; gained beaches (minus snowy) and Terralith swamp coverage. BABY SIZE 0.4.2: baby_scale moved 0.5 -> 1.0. The client already bakes the baby mesh through vanilla's BabyModelTransform (body halved, head full size) and vanilla age scaling halves the hitbox, so a 0.5 here was a SECOND shrink and calves rendered at a quarter of adult size. 1.0 = vanilla baby proportions. TERRALITH PASS: excludes Terralith's ice_marsh (frozen swamp).
